definitions.acs_window: 2020–2024 ACS 5-year estimates; geography definition for 2024, not annual or quarterly observations

acs_missing_codes.-555555555: Estimate controlled: sampling error not appropriate / MOE not calculated
acs_missing_codes.open_ended_median: Open-ended median: numeric point estimate unavailable; original positive source code retained in acs_qualified_medians

definitions.acs_boundary_note: Direct Census place GEOID join. The separate 2025 cartographic display boundaries may differ from 2024 ACS geography; do not use them to redistribute ACS estimates.

government_items.E50: Housing and community development current operations

definitions.government_units: Thousands of nominal USD as reported; fiscal year 2024 sample input, retain item data-year and fiscal-year-ending code MMDD
definitions.government_join: Exact 12-character government ID between finance and PID directory; FIPS state + official FIPS place only for municipality type 2. No fuzzy names, no township/headquarters proxy.
definitions.government_caution: Census edited individual-unit data only to produce state/type aggregates, not accurate individual-unit time series. These are sample inputs with potential substantial sampling and nonsampling error, imputation and nonresponse. Missing units/items are not zero; the Census Bureau has not reviewed or endorsed this derived city join or analysis. E23, E29 and E50 are expenditures, not staffing or comprehensive administrative capacity.
definitions.spatial_note: Spatial context, when available, uses unsimplified TIGER/Line 2024 municipal/place polygons, never simplified display boundaries. It is contextual geography, not a funded project or beneficiary footprint.
definitions.nfhl_definition: FEMA regulatory SFHA polygon flag T, unioned before intersection area. Full 2024 city administrative boundary including water is the denominator; mapped coverage and undetermined-zone area are explicit. Unmapped is unknown, not no risk. No actual flood-occurrence measure. Not an individual-property determination.
definitions.nfhl_vintage: NFHL_Key_Layers_20260303.gdb public national edition; cached from FEMA 2026-04-19, individual panels have varying effective dates
definitions.nfhl_method: Read bounding-box candidate polygons; clip to city bounding box, repair topology with structure method, intersect unsimplified 2024 TIGER place and transform to local NAD83 Lambert azimuthal equal-area. Union areas avoid overlap counting.
definitions.nlcd_definition: USGS Annual NLCD Land Cover 2024 Collection 1.1. 30 m pixel-center zonal counts. Developed classes 21–24, wetlands 90/95; land denominator excludes class 11 open water. Missing raster cells excluded and cell counts retained. This is land cover, not land use or zoning.
definitions.nfhl_topology_note: Repair native candidates before intersection and repair any invalid geometry after projection; no invented area allocation. Two projection-induced topology conflicts were reprocessed with valid polygon geometry.
definitions.nlcd_crs: NAD83 to WGS84 operation 1, stated 4 m accuracy, then native Albers. Explicit finite-coordinate and inverse checks; raster edge uncertainty remains at 30 m.
definitions.lcms_definition: USDA Forest Service LCMS modeled land-use classes; 2024 annual product, version 2025-11. Pixel-center zonal counts on 2024 TIGER places. Regional/national modeling product, not zoning, parcel permissions or legal boundary determination.

employment.vintage: March 2025; payroll standardized to 31-day March equivalent
employment.join: Exact new 6-digit government PID in ASPEP ID/data files and 2024 GUS directory; type 2 municipality on both sides, active Y, FIPS state agreement, valid direct ACS place GEOID. The legacy ASPEP state code is NOT FIPS. No name, headquarters or county proxy join.

flags.R: Reported or compiled from respondent information
flags.Q: Growth rate applied to prior donor imputation

employment.caution: March 2025 ASPEP annual sample benchmark input. Census reviews individual units to support aggregate estimates and warns against treating these files as accurate individual-unit time series. Retain item flags and sampling coverage. This is municipality-wide employment, not CDBG-DR staffing, program capacity, FTEs or award-time staffing. Missing municipalities/items are not zeros.
employment.units: Employees: persons, full-time and part-time separate. Payroll: nominal USD for standardized March month. Do not add total 000 to functions.
